title: Brownie Armadillo
description: Simplifies and saturates the armadillo texture to be more inline with the pixel art version on the MC launcher
body:
Simplfies and re-textures the Armadillo and its' scute to be closer to the MC mob vote style, and its' MC launcher loading texture.

No plans to update ~~the spawn egg~~ (good news and bad news! The vanilla spawn egg isn't changed but I've added compat with MobCrates! - follow instructions in the 2.1 changelog :D) or wolf armour bc I don't use either in my survival world at all, but if someone asks nicely I guess I'll give it a go
